cases.title: The full suite passes with no branchFormat set
cases.given: Branch sdlc/S-021 at fecc565; no branchFormat in any fixture config.
cases.when: Run npm test in a worktree of the branch.
cases.then: All tests pass, including next-action tests.

cases.title: The decision equals main's for 195 default-format fixtures, under absent, empty and null branchFormat
cases.given: Fixtures in pr, stack and direct mode: open and merged PR heads (slice, fix, split, state with and without stamp, milestone, e2e, lowercase, foreign, empty), mixed PR lists, and local branches with in-progress slices. Each runs with the key absent, empty and null.
cases.when: Run next-action.py from main (8450221) and from the branch with the same repo and prs file.
cases.then: Exit code and stdout are identical.

evidence.title: differential run
evidence.inline:
compared 585 differences 0
✔ default format decisions equal main for absent, empty and null branchFormat
exit 0

cases.title: A milestone branch with an in-progress entry is no longer an active slice branch
cases.given: Local branches sdlc/S-fix-M-1-1 and sdlc/M-1; both carry an in-progress entry.
cases.then: The active branch is sdlc/S-fix-M-1-1. Main chose sdlc/M-1.

seeds.title: Default-format decision differs from main for a milestone branch holding an in-progress entry
seeds.detail: Main read sdlc/M-1 as a slice branch if its slices.json held an in-progress entry with id M-1. The new code reads slice kind only. The state never writes such an entry, so the change is harmless and matches the intent.
